page.notes: Scan is slightly skewed; some letters at the top-left edge are cut off, so the opening fragment "ta" and "speros" are doubtful. "speros" [?] may be "sperorum". Underlined words in the text ("Quaecunq;", "Consideranda") are printed with underlining or decoration, transcribed as plain text. Show-through from the reverse side is visible faintly and was left out. The final "re-" sits at the right below the last line and is treated as a catchword.
